description: Guidelines for traveling with portable charger in your luggage.

carryOn.reason: Lithium-ion power banks / portable chargers are strictly prohibited in checked baggage because of the risk of thermal runaway and fire. They must be carried in the cabin.

checkedBag.reason: Portable chargers contain lithium-ion batteries and are prohibited in checked baggage because they present a fire hazard in the cargo hold.

tsa.pageTitle: Can I bring portable charger on a plane?

travelTips: Lithium-ion power banks / portable chargers are strictly prohibited in checked baggage because of the risk of thermal runaway and fire. They must be carried in the cabin.

faq.question: Is portable charger allowed in carry-on bags?
faq.answer: Portable Charger is allowed in carry-on luggage. Lithium-ion power banks / portable chargers are strictly prohibited in checked baggage because of the risk of thermal runaway and fire. They must be carried in the cabin.

faq.question: Can you pack portable charger in checked baggage?
faq.answer: No, Portable Charger is not allowed in checked bags. Portable chargers contain lithium-ion batteries and are prohibited in checked baggage because they present a fire hazard in the cargo hold.
